simple.meaning: גִּלֹה (Gilôh) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H1542). BibleIQ follows its 2 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Joshua, 2 Samuel, beginning at Joshua 15:51. The surrounding context includes offering, sacrifice, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name גִּלֹה (H1542).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.
